title: The server and viewer protocol is written down before it is built
body:
The server and its viewers talk over decade's own protocol (see the note on decade-da02e3). Before any code, the protocol goes into a spec under `docs/`, beside `docs/protocol.md`, which covers the existing pane socket.

The spec can copy an existing protocol's ideas, or copy one and change it, but decade does not commit to any standard.

## Proposal

The spec covers how a viewer connects and says hello, versioning, message framing, the viewer's size and scale, frames (dmabufs with fences locally, and room for encoded frames remotely), input events, cursor, clipboard, and how the server paces frames to a viewer.
